roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description: We are seeking a dedicated Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN) for a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital full-time role offers a competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, reflecting our commitment to attracting top talent.In this dual-focused position, you will be instrumental in both enhancing staff competencies through comprehensive training programs and ensuring the highest standards of infection prevention and control. Your expertise will directly contribute to the safety and well-being of our residents and staff.If you are an experienced RN with a passion for education and public health, and are looking for a rewarding opportunity to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply today.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2 years of experience in a long-term care setting
Demonstrated experience in staff education or development
Strong knowledge of infection prevention and control principles and regulations
